source.title: WSOT Leader Announcement (November 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Ethan Pride will become the new Leader of the WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT). 

Ethan was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0 - Committees and Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

WSOT is a new team and we wish Ethan Pride best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Ethan’s candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/14cti23WTQrtc01gZRwoTGerFiqIniDRn/view?usp=share_link) if you are interested in viewing it.

translation.title: WCA 体育组织团队负责人任命公告（2022 年 11 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Ethan Pride 将担任 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）的新负责人。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的[议案](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0 - Committees and Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Ethan，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

WSOT 是新成立的团队，祝 Ethan Pride 履新顺利。

如有兴趣，可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/14cti23WTQrtc01gZRwoTGerFiqIniDRn/view?usp=share_link)查看 Ethan 的申请材料。
